paragraphs: He taught Rav about the properties of fish, as in Moed Katan 11a.[^1]

notes.text: He is the contextual heading subject who taught Rav about fish, not the reverse. כ is read as as in, superseding the old See wording without changing the source. Moed Katan 11a is conventional from מו״ק יא.; no named-edition verification or identity binding is claimed.
